Name: BathHouse Improvements
Author: SashaSandd
Description:
This mods changes the interior of the bath house entrance, as well as adds details to both lockers and pool area.
Completely removes all damaged floor tiles and walls and make it look less boring and more lively. 
Also includes the explorable top floor of the bath house we can see but can't access in the main game.
Work like a semi greenhouse too but with very limited space.

[size=3][b]Compatible with:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42636]Solarium at the Spa Revisited Mod
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22565]Bathhouse Hot Spring - Continued
[/url][b]NOT COMPATIBLE IF YOU USE THEM BOTH AT THE SAME TIME!!﻿ [/b][i][size=3](for now)[/size][/i]
